rules.description: Content that targets an individual or group with insults, threats, or degrading language.
Repetitive, low-value, or unsolicited promotional content, including engagement-bait and scam links.
Claims that are factually false or misleading in a way that could cause real-world harm (health, safety, elections).
Content that encourages, instructs, or glorifies self-harm or suicide.
Content that does not violate any policy above.
